basic_profile.bio: I'm a 37-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, with a deep passion for gaming, especially the Souls series. When I'm not coding or gaming, I enjoy exploring new tech and contributing to open-source projects. My evenings are often spent unwinding with a good sci-fi novel or catching up on space documentaries. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of remote work, which allows me to game at odd hours. I often browse Reddit in the evenings or late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a computer science degree and over a decade of experience in software development. My expertise lies in backend development and system architecture. I've self-taught a lot about gaming mechanics and strategies through countless hours of playing and participating in online forums.
